name: zmath_vec3_div_scalar
description: zMath_Vec3_DivScalar divides a vector by a scalar, copying the input vector unchanged when the scalar is zero.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison remains blocked: current source has required docblock and source-faithful zero-divisor copy/alias behavior, but vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs leaves 2 unmasked byte mismatches because VC5 loads vec->x before multiplying by the reciprocal; retail duplicates the reciprocal with fld st0 then multiplies [ecx].
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4727a0 shows a fastcall vector/scalar helper with stdcall scalar cleanup, a zero-scalar branch that copies vec to out unless both pointers alias, and a nonzero branch that writes vec components multiplied by 1.0f / scalar.
The native smoke verifies nonzero division, zero-scalar copy-out behavior, and zero-scalar alias preservation.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4727a0 failed on 2026-06-05 under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs with 2 unmasked mismatches after masking 8 relocation bytes and trimming 3 trailing VC NOP bytes; BN size 77 and VC object symbol size 80. A six-profile VC5SP3 sweep tied at 2 mismatches, and direct x-component division spelling was byte-neutral at 2 mismatches.
